title: He moved about the kitchen softly, righting her breakfast things on the humpy tray.
html_source:
A subtle but lovely reference to Bloom the husband, caring and slightly effete, moving softly through the kitchen and making sure Molly’s breakfast things are righted.

We meet Bloom as he makes breakfast for Molly. In the final chapter, Bloom asks Molly to make him breakfast in bed.
